input: The project database of the active project (the binding its settings give: a local file or a LAN/intranet endpoint), the table modules the composing process serves, and requests: module id and payload.
output: Replies of the table modules, in order. The intermediary opens only an existing database whose public_project_settings names that project, never creates it, keeps its journal policy (PERSIST unless WAL: the project directory denies deletion), waits for other writers, and runs every request of a process through one serial writer. It holds no SQL of any domain; each table module owns its tables, schema and requests and is handed a connection. User rules 2026-09-25/26: the project owns its database, no application owns it, applications send through this intermediary.
specification: QNC_v5 qnc-host/src/project/db_broker.rs (ProjectDbBroker::serialize_project_write) and qnc-host/src/ingest/db.rs (ingest tables in the project database).
